headline: Mother dies from electrocution just hours before daughter's wedding
summary: A festive atmosphere turned into tragedy in Panchagarh as a mother, Rosena Begum (50), was electrocuted while preparing for her daughter's wedding. The joyous occasion was immediately suspended following her sudden death.
details: A mother, Rosena Begum (50), tragically died from electrocution in Panchagarh Sadar Upazila's Bhandaru village on Wednesday night, just hours before her daughter's wedding. The festive preparations for the ceremony instantly turned into profound mourning, leading to the immediate suspension of all wedding arrangements.

The incident occurred around 10:30 PM. Rosena Begum, wife of Elias Pramanik, was busy with last-minute preparations for her 22-year-old daughter's wedding, which was scheduled for Thursday night. The family had even slaughtered a cow for the guests.

According to family members, Rosena Begum went to switch on an electric fan in the cowshed. She accidentally touched a live electrical wire hanging near the switch, causing her to be electrocuted and thrown back. Relatives found her unconscious and rushed her to Panchagarh Modern Sadar Hospital, where doctors declared her dead.

Saiful Islam, Rosena Begum's nephew, confirmed the suspension of the wedding. She was buried in the family graveyard on Thursday afternoon. The family's only son, who lives in Saudi Arabia, will return before a new wedding date is set. Panchagarh Sadar Police Station Officer-in-Charge Mokhlesur Rahman confirmed the death by electrocution and stated that an unnatural death case has been filed.

headline_marked: [[1500 Yaba pills found in government ambulance]] in Manikganj, 3 arrested for smuggling
headline: 1500 Yaba pills found in government ambulance in Manikganj, 3 arrested for smuggling
summary: Three individuals, including the ambulance driver, were arrested after 1500 Yaba pills, worth BDT 4.5 lakh, were discovered in a government ambulance in Manikganj. Police claim the suspects admitted to using the official vehicle to smuggle drugs.
details: Detective Branch (DB) police in Manikganj have arrested three individuals on charges of smuggling Yaba in a government ambulance. Authorities recovered 1500 Yaba pills from the vehicle, with an estimated market value of BDT 4.5 lakh.
The raid was conducted on Thursday (August 27) afternoon in the Beutha Mor area of Sadar Upazila. This operation led to the immediate apprehension of the suspects and seizure of the contraband.

The arrested individuals are identified as ambulance driver Rozaul Karim Khan Milon (41), and alleged Yaba traders Farid Mohammad Soikat (47) and Khandaker Atikur Rahman Rubel (40). All three are residents of Manikganj Sadar Upazila.
Manabendra Balo, In-charge of Manikganj DB Police, confirmed the incident. He stated that the DB police acted on a tip-off, targeting a government ambulance belonging to Manikganj Medical College.

During interrogation, the arrested individuals reportedly confessed to using the government ambulance for a long time to transport Yaba, aiming to evade police detection. A case has been filed at Manikganj Sadar Police Station regarding this incident.
